questions.text: What is the address of your current website?

What kind of access to your content can you give: an API token from the CMS, an editor invite, or none (we then read the public pages)? Say only which kind. Secrets such as tokens and passwords never go into this chat, the repository or the report: you set them up yourself when they are needed.
What is the organisation's name, legal name and organisation number?
Which languages should the site have, and which one is the default?
How do you want to count visitors?
questions.help: Built-in analytics needs no outside service and stores no IP addresses. Other tools are custom work, and always wait for consent.

questions.text: We found these third-party services on your site. Which should the new site keep?
questions.help: Every kept service gets a consent category; YouTube loads from youtube-nocookie.

questions.text: Who is the data controller, and where is your privacy page?
Should the site have its own search?
Which forms do you need, who should get the submissions, and for how many days should they be kept?
Which accessibility level should the site meet, and do you want an accessibility statement?
Which content should we bring over?

options.label: Pages, and news from the last few years

questions.text: Who will edit the site? Names, e-mail addresses and roles.
Which domain will the site use, who controls its DNS, and when should it go live?
Do you accept the data processing agreement and hosting in the EU/EEA?
Should the new site embed anything simple the old one does not have, such as a map, a video or a form?
questions.help: Only simple embeds. Connections to other systems (a CRM, a shop, a member area, a job feed) are not part of a move; they are custom work.
